checks.description: Hub routes to audience-segmentation and offer-and-angle.

checks.rule: Output section names segments[], angle, offer_framing, channel_plan, and success_metric, matching handoff-contract.md.

checks.description: No em dash character anywhere in the file.
checks.rule: The file contains zero U+2014 em dash characters.

checks.description: Any digits are Western numerals only.
checks.rule: No Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669) appear; digits are 0-9 only.

checks.description: No tatweel or kashida in any Arabic.
